I replied to Ilse in our DM and confirmed the change: Bay 41 is now her dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Cinder project.

I can't store anything that carries over between conversations, so I didn't promise to remember it on my own. Her message in our DM is the record. If she points me back to that DM later, I can find it there. I also told her it stays between the two of us and won't come up anywhere else. Nothing else needed doing.
